name: The End Of Days
overview: The End of Days, as revealed in Scripture, speaks of a time of unparalleled tribulation and judgment, emphasizing the necessity of enduring faith to attain salvation. Jesus warns of a great tribulation unlike any before, urging believers to enter through the narrow gate to avoid destruction. While the exact timing remains known only to the Father, the promise of a new heavens and new earth assures a restored creation where former sorrows will be forgotten.
